title: Second-Jet Equivariant $η$ Separations on Lens Spaces
summary: Lens spaces are useful test examples in spectral geometry because their spin Dirac eigenspaces admit explicit congruence descriptions. We use these descriptions to study equivariant $η$ invariants for three-dimensional lens spaces with the round metric and the standard coordinate-torus action, retaining the spin-Fourier character of each eigenspace rather than only the ordinary scalar $η$ value.
